feature_construction.label: 特征构造
feature_construction.scope: Construct input features solely from supplied training interactions, such as frequency or recency indicators. No external metadata, independent scorer or score fusion. Keep learned embedding design, registered model topology, readout, loss and optimizer fixed.

embedding_representation.label: 嵌入表征
embedding_representation.scope: Item embedding dimensions, parameterization, tying and embedding normalization. Keep feature definitions, interaction/scoring mechanism, registered model topology, history policy, loss and optimizer fixed.

architecture_interaction.label: 架构与交互
architecture_interaction.scope: Coordinate backbone-appropriate blocks (GRU recurrence, NextItNet causal convolution, BERT4Rec masked bidirectional attention, or HSTU gated attention), feed-forward structure, residual paths and jointly trained interaction/scoring formulas such as bilinear compatibility. Keep the registered backbone family, input features, embedding parameterization, sequence selection/readout, loss and optimizer fixed. No independent scorer fusion.

sequence_interest.label: 序列与兴趣
sequence_interest.scope: Coordinate observed-history truncation, position representation and readout of encoder states, including recency or attention pooling. Keep input feature definitions, embedding parameterization, backbone topology, scoring formula, loss and optimizer fixed. Never introduce future interactions or change supplied splits.

learning_objective.label: 学习目标
learning_objective.scope: Ranking/prediction loss, loss weighting and jointly trained auxiliary objectives. Preserve feature definitions, embeddings, registered model topology, scoring/readout, optimizer, sampling, scheduler and batch/epoch settings.

hyperparameter_tuning.label: 联合调参
hyperparameter_tuning.scope: Jointly tune multiple numeric/categorical hyperparameters of the existing program: embedding/hidden dimensions, backbone depth, attention heads where applicable, convolution kernel size where applicable, feed-forward width, max history length, learning rate, dropout, weight decay, batch size, optimizer choice and scheduler settings. A candidate may change any compatible subset together; explain their coupling. Keep the current feature definitions, embedding parameterization/tying, interaction formula, readout formula, loss definition and registered model family. Do not add new computational modules or change data splits, seed 42, epoch cap 200, batches per epoch 200 or GPU/CPU allocation.

regular_routing: one TS draw for each of six arms; select top four without replacement
gpu_budget_allocation: selection frequency allocates slots over rounds; equal per-candidate caps within a group; charge actual worker duration
regular_reward: Bernoulli success iff valid host validation strictly exceeds the group-start local incumbent
jump_routing: budget-safe batch of up to four unique combinations, each with 2-4 directions spanning at least two parents; only best valid candidate opens one retune window
jump_credit: one delayed combination_jump outcome counter; no unidentifiable component-direction credit and no separate prior for each pair
edit_contract: exact selected direction set, per-direction nontrivial AST edits, logged rationale; semantic scope prompt-enforced
